detail.rationale: The root blocker (pid 93891) is a batch_worker running batch_replayable_inventory that has been idle in transaction for 4 seconds with an open transaction, blocking 1 session and contributing to 12 total sessions waiting on locks. Checkout success rate has dropped to 55% with 27 timeouts in the last 15 seconds (TEL-1). Since this is a replayable batch workload, terminating it will release locks immediately with minimal business impact as the work can be replayed.
